where_it_fails: The source-check misses lowercase invented details: of 9 planted inventions, 2 were missed (red bicycle; three weeks). The check extracts only capitalised name/place phrases and numeric or full written dates.
The check is a surface comparison, not a proof: a candidate counts as grounded when its words appear in the source telling, so a new combination of the storyteller's own words could pass unflagged.
The false-flag result rests on one small clean draft (3 candidates checked).
Count-correction adoption is measured only for the narrow deliberate-correction shapes the shipped detector recognises.
